events.title: First General Meeting
events.summary: Kick off the semester with CISA! Meet the club and e-board, hear what's planned, and connect with other students.
events.description: Special guest presentation: Cyberdeck Demonstration by Abington alum Pavlo Krykavskyi — see a custom-built Cyberdeck in action and learn how it was created.

events.title: Come Hack — Hands-on Cybersecurity Practice
events.summary: Biweekly hands-on session: learn how real systems are attacked, defended, investigated, and analyzed. Laptop recommended; workstations available.
events.description: Led by Moussa Toure. Guided learning plus practical labs on cyber ranges (TryHackMe, OffSec Labs, Hack Smarter, PortSwigger) and custom-built labs. No prior experience required.

events.title: Cybersecurity Beyond the Classroom
events.summary: Natalie Sylvester, a former CISA treasurer, will share her experience and insights on cybersecurity beyond the classroom.
events.description: Cybersecurity Beyond the Classroom: Join Natalie Sylvester, a former CISA treasurer, for a discussion on cybersecurity in the real world. Learn about her experiences, career insights, and how cybersecurity concepts extend beyond the classroom into professional environments.

events.title: CISA: Final Answer
events.summary: Test your cybersecurity and IT knowledge in a fun game-day competition featuring Jeopardy, Kahoot, Blooket, prizes, and pizza.
events.description: Test your knowledge of cybersecurity and IT through a fun Jeopardy-style competition! Join CISA for questions, challenges, prizes, and pizza while competing with friends and fellow students. Enjoy Kahoot, Blooket, and other interactive games. All are welcome!

events.title: Trace the Hacker
events.summary: Work with a team to investigate a simulated hacking incident, analyze clues, and discover what happened.
events.description: Put your cybersecurity skills to the test! Work with your team to investigate a simulated hacking incident, follow the clues, analyze the evidence, and figure out what happened. Solve the mystery and see if you can trace the hacker.
